parsed.observations: Wheat leaves and spikes are visible. Several leaves have elongated tan to orange-brown streaks and irregular patches, some following veins. Individual raised pustules, torn epidermis, and black dots are not clearly resolved; no white powdery growth is visible.
parsed.summary: Visible leaf streaks and necrotic patches indicate damage, but diagnostic pustule details or pycnidia are insufficiently resolved to identify an allowed disease class.
